description: Grande Nature Morte au Pichet oil on panel 17 ½ x 25 ½ in. (44.5 x 64.8 cm.)
provenance: Dr. Leonard Gow (1859–1936), Glasgow, before 1928. His sale; Christie's, London, 28 May 1937, lot 65, as Still Life. Ian McNicol (1908-1979), Glasgow, acquired at the above sale. Private collection, UK. Donated to support Cancer Relief, Macmillan Fund by the above. Their sale; Christie's, London, 29 June 1992, lot 3. Acquired at the above sale by the present owner.
